title: MultiSearch: first success wins
prompt:
Write `MultiSearch(ctx context.Context, query string, sfs []SearchFunc) (Result, error)`.

- Run every `SearchFunc` at once and return the first successful result without waiting for the rest.
- Cancel the `ctx` the losers got, and don't leak their goroutines.
- All fail → the last error received. `ctx` ends first → `ctx.Err()`. No funcs → any error.

Fast `{"a"}` in 10 ms, slow `{"b"}` in 1 s → `{"a"}` after ~10 ms.
hint: Derive a cancellable ctx, `defer cancel()`, and collect into a channel buffered to `len(sfs)` so late senders never block.
